title: By the Runway
style: jazz, big band swing, 126 BPM, syncopated ride cymbal, walking bass, brushed snare accents, muted brass stabs, trombone section glissandi, tenor sax riffs, piano comping, vibraphone voicings, live drum kit, dry room mics, tape saturation, punchy kick, call and response, defiant resolve, bittersweet nostalgia, lush harmonies, shehnai, jazz hip hop, tribal chants
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wait by the runway, watching for the light
Domain on approach, coming in tonight
Non-stop look up while we hold the line
Nslookup dot co, perfect landing time

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't run away now, stay and play
We got the signal on the way

[Chorus]
Nslookup dot co is here to play
Look up our domains all night, all day
How did you hear? On the new site, Lookcy
SongPal in the pocket, cool and easy

[Verse 2]
Song book in the air, text book turned to song
Catch you on the flip side, sing it all night long
Lookcy over here, different and better
Songpal dot cyou, lighter than a letter

[Bridge]
Runway lights blinking, wheels touch down
Name in the sky, tech in the sound
Wordplay fleet and the hook comes through
Look up the future, it looks like you

[Chorus]
Nslookup dot co is here to play
Look up our domains all night, all day
How did you hear? On the new site, Lookcy
SongPal in the pocket, cool and easy
